note: Set A captures more of the page's substantive millwork specifications with correct bindings — the 1/2" MDF and 3/4" MDF gable build-ups with P3 finish, 2"x6" framing, QZ countertop, bulkhead clad w/ gyp & fin. w/ P3, the MIN. 12" clear above requirement, the 2'-5 1/16" laundry millwork width, and the 6'-7 1/2" / 8'-4" / 2'-2 3/16" elevation dimensions. Set B is cleaner in count but loses the 12" clearance, the gable build-up and the laundry dimension, repeats the same scale fact under two garbled names, and states a flat contradiction (MWK04 width given as both 2'-0" and 6'-7 1/2"). A's main weakness is a cluster of unsupported DINING TABLE attributes (top thickness 5", clearance 6", height 3'-0") plus a fabricated MWK04+MWK05 combined width; B's weakness is noise (vague 'millwork' height duplicating the island height, trivial tag claims) and the misbound 6'-7 1/2" and 8" values.
remarks: The 5" and 6" values in the D5 island-section-thru-sink block sit next to QZ/2'-0"/F1/SK, i.e. at the island counter and sink, not at the dining table (whose own dims in D5 are 2'-7" and 2'-1", which neither set captured); A binds both to the dining table, B binds 5" to a 'faucet/backsplash' entity that does not appear in the text layer. The two 3'-3 3/4" dims in D1 sum to the 6'-7 1/2" overall North Island width, so binding them individually to DW, MWK04 or MWK05 is not verifiable from the text layer alone; both sets do this and they disagree. The 8" in A1 is adjacent to the bulkhead note, so 'center module millwork base height' (B) and 'center module millwork dimension' (A) are both weak readings. Both sets omit the '1" EITHER SIDE' half of the platform clearance note and the DIRTT Breathe Wall reference (I-202).
